items.title: Tyrese Maxey’s signature defensive play is a home run when it works and a double play when it fails.
items.author: Austin Krell
items.body_excerpt:
Tyrese Maxey’s signature defensive play is a home run when it works and a double play when it fails.

With this offensive firepower, it will be an unstoppable play when it works.

The problem will be living with the moments it doesn’t work:
